europe_now.title: Russian cargo ship damaged in Gulf of Finland
europe_now.summary: A Russian cargo ship sustained damage after being targeted by a drone attack in the Gulf of Finland. Both Finnish and Russian authorities acknowledged the incident, which highlights escalating maritime security concerns in the region.

sources.headline: Russian ship damaged by drone attack in Gulf of Finland, Helsinki and Moscow say
Drone attack sets Russian cargo ship ablaze in Gulf of Finland

europe_now.title: Denmark exposes Russian assassination plot
europe_now.summary: Denmark formally accused Russia of orchestrating an assassination plot targeting a US-Ukrainian citizen and subsequently expelled a diplomat. European Union leadership strongly condemned the operation, noting that security threats from Moscow have become increasingly direct.

sources.headline: Russian threats ‘less and less hybrid,’ Von der Leyen says after assassination plot in Denmark
'Unacceptable': EU chief condemns alleged Russian plot to kill US-Ukrainian citizen

top_stories.title: EU and UK Post-Brexit Diplomacy
top_stories.summary: The European Union and the United Kingdom successfully reached a formal reset agreement following years of post-Brexit friction. This new accord is designed to normalize relations and foster closer cooperation between the two sides.

sources.headline: EU, UK reach reset deal after Brexit

top_stories.title: Social Unrest and Protests in France
top_stories.summary: Demonstrations across France continued as the social movement entered its sixth consecutive week of protests. Turnout figures varied between interior ministry estimates and numbers provided by participating trade unions.
